questions.answer: The documents do not settle either part. (1) T1.3:s13 says an overrun_error pulse is emitted and 'the word is discarded' when the word in the tdata output register is not read before another word is received. It does not say whether 'the word' is the newly received word or the older word in tdata, so retention of the older word is not stated. (2) T1.3:s11 says only that 'busy' is high 'when an operation is taking place'. It does not say whether busy spans start bit to stop bit, or when it asserts and deasserts on the receiver. The designer must specify which word is dropped on overrun and the exact receiver busy assertion and deassertion points.
